card: This PR speeds up wallet unit test execution by deduplicating wallet setup code and configuring test wallets with keypool_size = 1 rather than deriving the default 1000 keys. It targets slow feedback cycles during local development and continuous integration. The author reports test suite time reductions including coinselector_tests dropping from 8.26 s to 3.35 s and wallet_tests from 2.10 s to 1.68 s.
evidence: PR description benchmarks show runtime reductions across four unit test suites, notably dropping coinselector_tests from 8.26 s to 3.35 s and wallet_tests from 2.10 s to 1.68 s.
problem: Wallet unit test suites repeatedly initialize test wallets that pre-derive large default keypools of 1000 keys, unnecessarily slowing down unit test execution during development and CI.

risk.why: Modifications are confined to unit test wallet setup and have no effect on production wallet logic or release binaries.

scope_notes: Touches only unit test setup helpers across wallet test files.
summary: Reduces execution time for wallet unit test suites by configuring test wallets with a minimal keypool size of 1 instead of the default 1000. It also deduplicates wallet test setup code across test files into a shared helper function.
